class: A label keyword chose the answer: any question containing the word 'state' got the owner's state
symptom: Premier Health, 1 October: 'If applicable, has your professional license/certification (in any state) ever been revoked?' was answered 'Virginia'. The replay guard found the same on an earlier application: 'Have you ... worked for the US Government (e.g., ... State ...)?' -> 'Virginia'.
root_cause: PageAgent.known_answer gave profile.state to any question matching  (state|province) , outside the concept matcher that decides every other field kind.
why_tests_missed: State tests used short labels ('State', 'State/Province'); none put the word inside a yes/no question.
fix: known_answer gives the state only when concept_matcher.match_concept reads the question as STATE_PROVINCE. The replay guard showed exactly the two corrections above across 850 saved pages.
prevention: One place decides what a question asks (the concept matcher); no answer path matches a keyword on its own.
